campuses.title: Dubai International Academic City Campus
campuses.text: Кампус Birmingham в DIAC — современное purpose-built здание с lecture theatres, лабораториями, библиотекой и student hub. Кампус открыт в 2018, новое здание — в 2021 при участии Sheikh Hamdan.

paragraphs: The University of Birmingham Dubai is a branch campus of the University of Birmingham, a UK Russell Group university founded in 1900. The Dubai campus opened in 2018 in Dubai International Academic City (DIAC), with a purpose-built campus building inaugurated in 2021 by His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

Birmingham Dubai delivers the same UK-validated degrees as the home campus, with academic standards governed by the University of Birmingham UK Senate. Programmes are concentrated in Computer Science (AI, Machine Learning), Business and Finance, Engineering Management, and Digital Media — areas aligned with the UAE's economic strategy.

The Dubai campus is small and selective, with a cohort drawn from the UAE, Gulf, South Asia, Africa and Europe. Students benefit from the University of Birmingham's global ranking (top 100 worldwide by QS) and access to the UK campus for exchange and progression.

Tuition is set in AED with USD-equivalent ranges, and the university offers scholarships of up to 30% for high-achieving international applicants. All teaching is in English, with IELTS 6.5 as the standard entry requirement.
paragraphsRu: University of Birmingham Dubai — филиал University of Birmingham, британского Russell Group университета, основанного в 1900 году. Кампус Dubai открылся в 2018 в Dubai International Academic City (DIAC); новое purpose-built здание открыто в 2021 шейхом Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum.

Birmingham Dubai выдаёт те же UK-аккредитованные дипломы, что и кампус в Бирмингеме — стандарты курирует Senate University of Birmingham UK. Программы сосредоточены в Computer Science (AI, Machine Learning), Business and Finance, Engineering Management и Digital Media — направлениях, соответствующих стратегии развития ОАЭ.
Кампус компактный и селективный, студенты — из ОАЭ, Gulf, South Asia, Africa и Europe. Birmingham входит в топ-100 мира QS, студенты Dubai имеют доступ к обмену и переходу на UK-кампус.

Стоимость обучения указана в AED с USD-эквивалентом; университет предлагает стипендии до 30% для outstanding международных абитуриентов. Преподавание полностью на английском, базовое требование — IELTS 6.5.
